notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware backend exists and no hardware run is claimed. The package serves the QuadrotorPlusHoverEnv-v0 variant named by the first entry symbol; the repository also registers TiltrotorPlus8DofHoverEnv-v0 and QuadrotorXHoverEnv-v0, which are not covered. gym, mujoco_py and the clone are not importable where the gate runs, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python stand-in (fake.py), not the upstream simulator; it was not compared with the upstream environment and the sim backend (gym.make) was not run. The fake's action space is a four-element Box 0..1 taken from the model's actuator_ctrlrange; the action space inherited from gym's MuJoCo base class is outside the clone and was not compared with it; the fidelity gaps say so. Remaining warnings are the family-bridge ones: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x3 for action_space, observation_space and reset (inherited from gym's mujoco_env.MujocoEnv, which is outside the clone), and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the integer seed twice, ticks and the numeric action.values (the simulator's own units; the bridge derives them). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. Only catalogue classes (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1) are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
